Package ui

Class HotelSuiteScreen

java.lang.Object
ui.HotelSuiteScreen
public class HotelSuiteScreen extends Object
JavaFX controller for the Hotels & Suites screen (HotelSuiteScreen.fxml).

This screen allows hotel administrators to register and browse properties, suite tiers, and individual suite units. It contains three independent forms:

  • Add Hotel — registers a new hotel with name, theme, location, and declared suite count.
  • Add Suite Class — defines a new suite tier with a class name, nightly rate, and amenities description.
  • Add Suite — registers an individual suite unit under a selected hotel and suite class, with a suite number.

Two read-only tables on the right panel display all hotels and all suite classes currently in the database, refreshed after every successful insert.

The controller is instantiated and injected by the JavaFX FXMLLoader when HotelSuiteScreen.fxml is loaded.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called automatically by the JavaFX runtime after all @FXML fields have been injected.

      Responsibilities:

      • Binds all table columns to their respective model properties.
      • Instantiates HotelDAO.
      • Loads the hotel and suite class tables.
      • Populates the hotel and class combo boxes in the Add Suite form.

    • handleAddHotel

      private void handleAddHotel()
      Handles the "+ ADD HOTEL" button action.

      Validates that all four hotel fields are filled and that the suite count is a valid integer, then creates and persists a new Hotel. Clears the form, refreshes the hotel table, and repopulates the hotel combo box on success.

    • handleClearHotel

      private void handleClearHotel()
      Handles the "CLEAR" button action on the Add Hotel form. Resets all hotel input fields to their empty state.

    • handleAddClass

      private void handleAddClass()
      Handles the "+ ADD CLASS" button action.

      Validates that the class name and nightly rate are provided and that the rate is a valid number, then creates and persists a new SuiteClass. Clears the form, refreshes the suite class table, and repopulates the class combo box on success.

    • handleClearClass

      private void handleClearClass()
      Handles the "CLEAR" button action on the Add Suite Class form. Resets all class input fields to their empty state.

    • handleAddSuite

      private void handleAddSuite()
      Handles the "+ ADD SUITE" button action.

      Validates that a hotel, suite class, and suite number are all provided, extracts the hotel ID and class ID from the combo box selection strings, then creates and persists a new Suite. Clears the form on success.

    • handleClearSuite

      private void handleClearSuite()
      Handles the "CLEAR" button action on the Add Suite form. Resets the suite number field and both combo box selections.

    • handleHotelSelected

      private void handleHotelSelected()
      Handles a hotel selection change in the suiteHotelCombo. Repopulates the suite class combo box — currently loads all suite classes regardless of the selected hotel, since classes are shared across hotels.
